description: This file implements log tailing functionality, including resolving log files, reading log slices, and exporting a configured log tail function.

methods.name: isRollingLogFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the rolling log pattern.

methods.name: resolveLogFile
methods.description: Resolves the actual log file, especially when given a pattern or a non-existent file.

methods.name: readLogSlice
methods.description: Reads a slice of the log file based on cursor, limit, and maxBytes.

methods.name: readConfiguredLogTail
methods.description: Exports a log tail payload based on current logger settings and optional parameters.
